<style id="v21-final-adjustments">
/* V21 — accumulated review adjustments */
.hero-scroll{position:absolute;z-index:5;right:clamp(24px,4vw,72px);top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);margin:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:14px 18px 14px 12px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(7,10,15,.50);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.25),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06)}

.flow-step h3{font-size:clamp(23px,1.9vw,29px);line-height:1.02;margin:0;max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:break-word;hyphens:auto;text-wrap:balance}

.flow-step.warn{border:2px solid rgba(255,83,103,.62);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(88,25,48,.34),rgba(25,15,23,.84));box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,83,103,.12),0 26px 70px rgba(65,12,28,.30),inset 0 0 70px rgba(255,83,103,.06)}
.flow-step.warn::before{display:none}

<style id="mobile-official-overrides">
/* =========================================================
   MIV — MOBILE / TABLET OFFICIAL
   Final responsive layer. Desktop remains untouched >1024px.
   ========================================================= */
@media (max-width:1024px){
  :root{--mobile-pad:clamp(18px,4vw,34px)}

  .lede{font-size:17px;line-height:1.72}
  .eyebrow{font-size:11px;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:.15em;padding:9px 12px;margin-bottom:15px;white-space:normal}

  /* Header + menu */
  .site-header{position:fixed!important;top:0!important;left:0!important;right:0!important;width:100%!important;z-index:1000!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(6,8,12,.93),rgba(6,8,12,.70) 72%,transparent)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
  .site-header .wrap{min-height:76px!important;padding-top:max(6px,env(safe-area-inset-top));gap:14px}
  .brand img{height:54px!important;width:auto!important;max-width:190px!important}
